title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 — Ingredient Declarations

rules.title: List of Ingredients
rules.description: Every pre-packaged food shall declare a list of ingredients under the heading 'Ingredients', except where the food is a single-ingredient food.

rules.title: Descending Order of Composition
rules.description: Ingredients shall be listed in descending order of their composition by weight or volume, as determined at the time of manufacture.

rules.title: Declaration of Major Allergens
rules.description: Foods containing cereals with gluten, crustacea, milk, eggs, fish, peanuts, tree nuts, soybeans, or added sulphites (>=10 mg/kg) shall declare them.

rules.title: Food Additives and INS Numbering
rules.description: Food additives shall be declared by class name followed by the specific name or recognised International Numbering System (INS) number.

rules.title: Vegetarian / Non-Vegetarian Symbol
rules.description: Every package shall bear a green filled circle in a green square (vegetarian) or a brown filled triangle in a brown square (non-vegetarian) on the principal display panel.
